description: National Register of Road Haulage and Road Passenger Transport Operators is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency. This data contains information on known Goods and Passenger Vehicle Operators that run a business for hire and reward (holders of Standard Licences) within GB. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
